<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow character</title>
<style>
  html, body { width: 240px; height: 294px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 294px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 294);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120, 120, 147, -147, 1, 1600);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.set(0, 0, 700);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const noiseGLSL = `
  float grain(vec2 p) {
    vec3 h = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    h += dot(h, h.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((h.x + h.y) * h.z);
  }
`;

const studio = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthTest: false,
  depthWrite: false,
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.999, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    ${noiseGLSL}
    void main() {
      float y = 1.0 - vUv.y;
      vec3 color = mix(vec3(0.790, 0.776, 0.749), vec3(0.938, 0.939, 0.919),
                       smoothstep(0.0, 0.30, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.998, 0.998, 0.988), smoothstep(0.15, 0.50, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.962, 0.963, 0.942), smoothstep(0.71, 0.80, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.652, 0.659, 0.615), smoothstep(0.77, 1.035, y));
      float side = (vUv.x - 0.5) * 0.018 * (1.0 - y);
      vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      float value = (grain(pixel) - 0.5) * (0.032 + 0.033 * abs(2.0 * y - 1.0));
      float chroma = (grain(pixel + vec2(38.1, 7.5)) - 0.5) * 0.04;
      color += vec3(side + value) + chroma * vec3(0.7, 0.28, -1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
    }
  `
}));
studio.name = 'gray-studio-background';
studio.frustumCulled = false;
studio.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(studio);

const surfaceVertex = `
  attribute vec3 restPosition;
  varying vec3 vRest;
  varying vec3 vNormal;
  varying vec2 vUv;
  void main() {
    vRest = restPosition;
    vUv = uv;
    vec3 n = normalMatrix * normal;
    vNormal = normalize(vec3(dot(viewMatrix[0].xyz, n),
                             dot(viewMatrix[1].xyz, n),
                             dot(viewMatrix[2].xyz, n)));
    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
  }
`;

function skinMaterial(mode) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      mode: { value: mode },
      raised: { value: 0 },
      strength: { value: 1 }
    },
    transparent: mode === 3,
    depthWrite: mode !== 3,
    vertexShader: surfaceVertex,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform int mode;
      uniform float raised;
      uniform float strength;
      varying vec3 vRest;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      ${noiseGLSL}

      vec3 skin(float y) {
        vec3 c = mix(vec3(0.900, 0.839, 0.389), vec3(0.866, 0.714, 0.284),
                     smoothstep(25.0, 63.0, y));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.963, 0.823, 0.329), smoothstep(61.0, 99.0, y));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.908, 0.727, 0.275), smoothstep(105.0, 174.0, y));
        return mix(c, vec3(0.817, 0.595, 0.226), smoothstep(170.0, 235.0, y));
      }

      void main() {
        float x = vRest.x + 120.0;
        float y = 147.0 - vRest.y;
        vec3 n = normalize(vNormal);
        vec3 color = skin(y);

        if (mode == 0 || mode == 3) {
          vec2 oval = vec2((x - 101.0) / 64.0, (y - 154.0) / 64.0);
          float front = smoothstep(-3.0, 28.0, vRest.z);
          float bellyMask = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.80, 1.025, length(oval))) * front;
          vec3 belly = mix(vec3(0.984, 0.915, 0.697), vec3(0.961, 0.873, 0.681),
                           smoothstep(104.0, 132.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, vec3(0.833, 0.759, 0.598), smoothstep(127.0, 162.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, vec3(0.877, 0.675, 0.323), smoothstep(158.0, 192.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, skin(y), smoothstep(190.0, 220.0, y));
          color = mix(color, belly, bellyMask);
          vec2 muzzle = vec2((x - 102.0) / 18.0, (y - 52.0) / 11.0);
          color -= exp(-dot(muzzle, muzzle)) * smoothstep(3.0, 23.0, vRest.z)
                   * vec3(0.025, 0.050, 0.025);
        } else if (mode == 1) {
          float armY = y - 16.0 * raised * (1.0 - smoothstep(172.0, 196.0, y));
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.510, 0.404, 0.183), smoothstep(143.0, 181.0, armY));
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.283, 0.252, 0.177), smoothstep(173.0, 196.0, armY));
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.245, 0.219, 0.164), smoothstep(196.0, 222.0, y));
          color += raised * smoothstep(182.0, 200.0, y) * vec3(0.055, 0.056, 0.043);
        } else {
          color = mix(vec3(0.829, 0.610, 0.245), vec3(0.665, 0.470, 0.204),
                      smoothstep(211.0, 300.0, y));
          float inside = x < 100.0 ? n.x : -n.x;
          color *= 1.0 - 0.15 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.93, inside);
        }

        vec3 key = normalize(vec3(-0.36, 0.63, 0.69));
        vec3 bounce = normalize(vec3(0.67, 0.37, -0.64));
        float light = 0.843 + 0.158 * max(dot(key, n), 0.0)
                    + 0.093 * max(dot(bounce, n), 0.0) - 0.045 * max(-n.y, 0.0);
        color *= light;
        vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
        vec2 fleck = floor(vec2(vRest.x + vRest.z * 0.44, vRest.y - vRest.z * 0.27) * 1.32);
        color += (grain(pixel) - 0.5) * vec3(0.048, 0.051, 0.061);
        color += (grain(fleck) - 0.5) * vec3(0.037, 0.033, 0.024);
        color += (grain(pixel + vec2(74.6, 5.2)) - 0.5) * vec3(0.027, 0.014, -0.039);

        float alpha = 1.0;
        if (mode == 3) {
          alpha = strength * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.76, 1.0, length(vUv * 2.0 - 1.0)));
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), alpha);
      }
    `
  });
}

const torsoSkin = skinMaterial(0);
const leftSkin = skinMaterial(1);
const rightSkin = skinMaterial(1);
const legSkin = skinMaterial(2);
const eyelidSkin = skinMaterial(3);
const noseSkin = skinMaterial(3);

function point(x, y, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(x - 120, 147 - y, z);
}

function group(name, parent, x, y, z) {
  const node = new THREE.Group();
  node.name = name;
  node.userData.restPivot = point(x, y, z);
  node.position.copy(node.userData.restPivot);
  if (parent.userData.restPivot) node.position.sub(parent.userData.restPivot);
  parent.add(node);
  return node;
}

function profile(rows, y) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < rows.length - 2 && y > rows[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = rows[i];
  const b = rows[i + 1];
  const before = rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const after = rows[Math.min(rows.length - 1, i + 2)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((y - a[0]) / span, 0, 1);
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  return a.slice(1).map((value, index) => {
    const j = index + 1;
    const slopeA = (b[j] - before[j]) / (b[0] - before[0]);
    const slopeB = (after[j] - a[j]) / (after[0] - a[0]);
    return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * value + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * span * slopeA
         + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[j] + (t3 - t2) * span * slopeB;
  });
}

function addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices, normals) {
  const pivot = parent.userData.restPivot;
  const local = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
    local.push(positions[i] - pivot.x, positions[i + 1] - pivot.y, positions[i + 2] - pivot.z);
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(local, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('restPosition', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  if (normals) geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  else geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function loft(name, parent, material, rows, sides = 48, start = rows[0][0], end = rows.at(-1)[0]) {
  const positions = [];
  const normals = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const rings = Math.ceil((end - start) / 1.55);

  for (let j = 0; j <= rings; j++) {
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(start, end, j / rings);
    const [x, rx, rz, z] = profile(rows, y);
    const early = Math.max(rows[0][0], y - 0.05);
    const late = Math.min(rows.at(-1)[0], y + 0.05);
    const low = profile(rows, early);
    const high = profile(rows, late);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = i * Math.PI * 2 / sides;
      const c = Math.cos(angle);
      const s = Math.sin(angle);
      const around = new THREE.Vector3(-rx * s, 0, rz * c);
      const down = new THREE.Vector3(
        high[0] - low[0] + (high[1] - low[1]) * c,
        early - late,
        high[3] - low[3] + (high[2] - low[2]) * s
      );
      positions.push(x + rx * c - 120, 147 - y, z + rz * s);
      normals.push(...around.cross(down).normalize().toArray());
      uvs.push(i / sides, j / rings);

      if (j < rings) {
        const a = j * sides + i;
        const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(a, b, a + sides, b, b + sides, a + sides);
      }
    }
  }

  for (const top of [true, false]) {
    const y = top ? start : end;
    const [x, , , z] = profile(rows, y);
    const middle = positions.length / 3;
    positions.push(x - 120, 147 - y, z);
    normals.push(0, top ? 1 : -1, 0);
    uvs.push(0.5, 0.5);
    const ring = top ? 0 : rings * sides;
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = ring + i;
      const b = ring + (i + 1) % sides;
      if (top) indices.push(middle, b, a);
      else indices.push(middle, a, b);
    }
  }
  return addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices, normals);
}

const character = group('character-yellow', scene, 99, 216, 0);
const torso = group('torso', character, 99, 120, 0);
const head = group('head', torso, 100, 67, 6);

// Each row is height in the reference image, center x, half-width, half-depth and depth.
const body = [

loft('body-volume', torso, torsoSkin, body, 96, 67, 237);

const legs = [];
for (const leg of [
  { side: 'left', pivot: 77, rows: [
    [196, 76, 1.0, 1.0, -3], [204, 75, 17.5, 20.5, -3],
    [218, 74.7, 18.2, 23.0, -3], [234, 77.0, 17.5, 21.3, -2],
    [252, 80.3, 15.5, 18.2, -2], [273, 83.8, 13.4, 14.2, -2],
    [294, 85.7, 10.7, 11.4, -1], [309, 86.1, 9.3, 10.3, 0],
    [316, 85.5, 10.5, 14.7, 3], [322, 85.0, 10.8, 16.4, 4],
    [326, 85.0, 0.3, 0.4, 5]
  ] },
  { side: 'right', pivot: 120, rows: [
    [196, 120, 1.0, 1.0, -3], [204, 121, 17.6, 21.0, -3],
    [218, 120.5, 18.0, 22.4, -3], [234, 118.4, 16.6, 20.2, -3],
    [252, 116.5, 14.8, 17.0, -3], [273, 115.1, 12.6, 13.2, -3],
    [294, 113.5, 10.3, 10.8, -2], [309, 113.4, 9.0, 10.1, -1],
    [316, 114.0, 10.0, 14.0, 2], [322, 114.4, 10.5, 15.8, 3],
    [326, 114.6, 0.3, 0.4, 4]
  ] }
]) {
  const limb = group(`leg-${leg.side}`, character, leg.pivot, 211, -3);
  loft(`leg-and-foot-volume-${leg.side}`, limb, legSkin, leg.rows);
  legs.push(limb);
}

function addHand(side, arm, material, palm, fingers, wrist) {
  const hand = group(`hand-${side}`, arm, ...wrist);
  loft('palm-volume', hand, material, palm, 36);
  const names = ['little-finger', 'ring-finger', 'middle-finger', 'index-finger', 'thumb'];
  const digits = fingers.map((rows, i) => {
    const [y, x, , , z] = rows[0];
    const finger = group(names[i], hand, x, y, z);
    loft(`${names[i]}-volume`, finger, material, rows, 20);
    return finger;
  });
  return { hand, digits, wrist };
}

const leftArm = group('arm-left', torso, 60, 91, -3);
const leftRows = [

], [

  [[197.2, 30.3, 1.5, 1.7, 0.5], [204.5, 27.8, 1.40, 1.35, 1.1], [210.8, 26.7, 1.05, 1.05, 1.8], [214.1, 27.6, 0.14, 0.16, 1.9]],
  [[198.4, 32.4, 1.65, 1.7, 1.2], [205.5, 31.0, 1.48, 1.4, 1.9], [211.5, 30.3, 1.1, 1.1, 2.8], [215.1, 31.3, 0.14, 0.16, 3.1]],
  [[197.1, 34.6, 1.6, 1.7, 1.8], [203.9, 34.1, 1.44, 1.35, 2.5], [209.4, 34.4, 1.03, 1.0, 3.1], [211.5, 35.2, 0.14, 0.16, 3.4]],
  [[190.6, 37.0, 1.45, 1.6, 1.9], [197.1, 37.9, 1.36, 1.3, 3.0], [202.0, 38.3, 1.0, 1.0, 3.5], [204.8, 37.5, 0.12, 0.15, 3.9]]
], [37, 186, 0]);

  [[202.5, 163.9, 1.55, 1.7, 0.5], [208.4, 167.3, 1.54, 1.46, 1.4], [215.6, 168.6, 1.1, 1.1, 2.1], [219.7, 168.0, 0.14, 0.16, 2.5]],
  [[203.6, 161.5, 1.65, 1.7, 1.1], [210.4, 164.2, 1.52, 1.43, 1.9], [216.7, 165.0, 1.12, 1.06, 2.9], [221.0, 164.0, 0.14, 0.16, 3.2]],
  [[202.8, 159.4, 1.55, 1.6, 1.7], [210.4, 160.7, 1.38, 1.34, 2.5], [216.9, 161.5, 0.99, 0.94, 3.3], [219.6, 160.6, 0.14, 0.16, 3.7]],
  [[196.9, 156.0, 1.58, 1.6, 1.8], [202.4, 155.2, 1.42, 1.32, 2.7], [208.2, 156.0, 1.06, 1.0, 3.1], [213.1, 157.2, 0.14, 0.16, 3.7]]

function armRig(arm, rows, material, handParts, elbowY, side) {
  const sides = 40;
  const mesh = loft(`arm-volume-${side}`, arm, material, rows, sides);
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  const { hand, digits, wrist } = handParts;
  const pivot = arm.userData.restPivot;
  const start = rows[0][0];
  const end = rows.at(-1)[0];
  const count = Math.ceil((end - start) / 1.55);
  function center(y) {
    const [x, , , z] = profile(rows, y);
    return point(x, y, z).sub(pivot);
  }
  const bands = Array.from({ length: count + 1 }, (_, i) => {
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(start, end, i / count);
    const low = Math.max(start, y - 0.08);
    const high = Math.min(end, y + 0.08);
    const derivative = center(high).sub(center(low)).multiplyScalar(1 / (high - low));
    return { y, center: center(y), derivative };
  });
  const [elbowX, , , elbowZ] = profile(rows, elbowY);
  return {
    arm, mesh, material, hand, digits, wrist, sides, bands, side,
    start, end, shoulderY: 147 - pivot.y, elbowY,
    elbow: center(elbowY), wristLocal: hand.position.clone(),
    positions: mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array.slice(),
    normals: mesh.geometry.getAttribute('normal').array.slice(),
    restPose: [elbowX, elbowY, elbowZ, ...wrist, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    restDirection: new THREE.Vector3(side === 'left' ? -5.5 : 5.5, -27, 2.2)
  };
}

const left = armRig(leftArm, leftRows, leftSkin, leftHand, 141, 'left');
const right = armRig(rightArm, rightRows, rightSkin, rightHand, 143, 'right');

function headFront(x, y) {
  const [center, halfWidth, halfDepth, depth] = profile(body, y);
  const xRatio = (x - center) / halfWidth;
  return depth + halfDepth * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.001, 1 - xRatio * xRatio));
}

function swelling(x, y, cx, cy, rx, ry, height) {
  const radiusSquared = ((x - cx) / rx) ** 2 + ((y - cy) / ry) ** 2;
  return height * Math.max(0, 1 - radiusSquared) ** 2;
}

function facePatch(parent, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, rise, material, order) {
  const positions = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 9;
  const sides = 40;
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const r = j === 0 ? 0.001 : j / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = i * 2 * Math.PI / sides;
      const u = r * Math.cos(angle);
      const v = r * Math.sin(angle);
      const x = cx + u * rx;
      const y = cy + v * ry;
      positions.push(...point(x, y, headFront(x, y) + 0.09 + rise(x, y)).toArray());
      uvs.push(0.5 + 0.5 * u, 0.5 + 0.5 * v);
      if (j < steps) {
        const a = j * sides + i;
        const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(a, b, a + sides, b, b + sides, a + sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const mesh = addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices);
  mesh.renderOrder = order;
  return mesh;
}

function creaseMaterial(rgb, opacity) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { ink: { value: new THREE.Vector3(...rgb) }, strength: { value: opacity } },
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 ink;
      uniform float strength;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        float ends = smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, vUv.x) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, 1.0 - vUv.x);
        float edge = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.07, 1.0, abs(vUv.y * 2.0 - 1.0));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(ink, strength * ends * edge);
      }
    `
  });
}

function crease(name, parent, controls, halfWidth, material, lift = () => 0) {
  const path = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(controls.map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0)));
  const positions = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 36;
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const t = i / steps;
    const p = path.getPoint(t);
    const d = path.getTangent(t);
    const w = halfWidth * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI));
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const x = p.x - d.y * w * side;
      const y = p.y + d.x * w * side;
      positions.push(...point(x, y, headFront(x, y) + 0.28 + lift(x, y)).toArray());
      uvs.push(t, (side + 1) / 2);
    }
    if (i < steps) {
      const a = i * 2;
      indices.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2);
    }
  }
  const mesh = addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices);
  mesh.renderOrder = 2;
  return mesh;
}

const irisSkin = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: { openness: { value: 0 } },
  transparent: true,
  depthWrite: false,
  vertexShader: surfaceVertex,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform float openness;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    ${noiseGLSL}
    void main() {
      vec2 p = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      p.y = (p.y - 0.12 * (1.0 - openness)) / mix(0.36, 1.0, openness);
      float r = length(p);
      float pupil = length((p - vec2(-0.025, 0.055)) * vec2(1.03, 0.90));
      vec3 c = mix(vec3(0.239, 0.470, 0.352), vec3(0.646, 0.700, 0.340),
                   smoothstep(0.47, 0.95, r));
      c = mix(vec3(0.029, 0.051, 0.040), c, smoothstep(0.35, 0.52, pupil));
      c += vec3(0.056, 0.073, 0.064) *
           (1.0 - smoothstep(0.04, 0.15, length(p - vec2(-0.19, -0.22))));
      c *= 0.89 + 0.11 * max(0.0, normalize(vNormal).y);
      c += (grain(floor(gl_FragCoord.xy)) - 0.5) * 0.041;
      float alpha = smoothstep(0.04, 0.45, openness) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.67, 0.99, r));
      gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(c, 0.0, 1.0), alpha);
    }
  `
});

const eyeShadow = creaseMaterial([0.48, 0.395, 0.16], 0.55);
const eyes = group('eyes', head, 101, 39, 24);
for (const eye of [
  { side: 'left', x: 88.2, y: 37.5, rx: 7.5, ry: 5.8, openX: 86.9,

const nose = group('nose', head, 101.5, 44, headFront(101.5, 44));
facePatch(nose, 'nose-volume', 101.5, 44, 5.7, 4.1,
  (x, y) => swelling(x, y, 101.5, 44, 5.7, 4.1, 1.85), noseSkin, 1);

const mouth = group('mouth', head, 102.4, 50.3, headFront(102.4, 50.3));
const lip = crease('lower-lip-light', mouth,
  [[93.2, 50.2], [98.3, 51.8], [103.6, 52.2], [109.1, 51.5], [113.0, 49.9]],
  0.93, creaseMaterial([0.921, 0.736, 0.322], 0.64));
const smile = crease('small-smile', mouth,
  [[90.9, 48.3], [95.5, 49.7], [101.4, 50.4], [107.7, 50.3], [112.3, 49.4], [114.6, 48.3]],
  1.03, creaseMaterial([0.345, 0.301, 0.124], 0.82));
lip.frustumCulled = false;
smile.frustumCulled = false;

function poseMouth([width, down, curve]) {
  const pivot = mouth.userData.restPivot;
  for (const mesh of [lip, smile]) {
    const original = mesh.geometry.getAttribute('restPosition');
    const pos = mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position');
    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
      const offset = original.getX(i) + 120 - 102.4;
      const x = 102.4 + offset * width;
      const y = 147 - original.getY(i) + down + curve * (1 - (offset / 12) ** 2);
      pos.setXYZ(i, x - 120 - pivot.x, 147 - y - pivot.y, headFront(x, y) + 0.28 - pivot.z);
    }
    pos.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

const frontAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
const upAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const sideAxis = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);

function palmBasis(direction) {
  const y = direction.clone().normalize().negate();
  const x = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(y, frontAxis).normalize();
  const z = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(x, y);
  return new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x, y, z));
}

function palmRotation(rig, [x, y, z, roll]) {
  const direction = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).normalize();
  const twist = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(direction, roll);
  return twist.multiply(palmBasis(direction)).multiply(palmBasis(rig.restDirection).invert());
}

const duration = 5540;
// Body poses give the hip position, scale, yaw, lean and pitch.
// Arm poses give elbow and wrist positions, palm scale and width, finger spread and curl, and arm girth.
// Hand directions use positive Y upwards. Leg poses give pitch, roll and depth for each leg.
const frames = [
  {
    t: 0, body: [99, 216, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    left: left.restPose, right: right.restPose,
    legs: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], mouth: [1, 0, 0], eyes: 0
  },
  {
    t: 800, body: [67, 222, 1.010, 0.908, 1.035, 0.35, -0.025, -0.012],
    left: [40, 127, 36, 75, 87, 52, 1.00, 1.06, -0.13, 0.51, 0.59],
    right: [111, 111, 33, 109, 88, 64, 0.94, 1.08, -0.16, 0.60, 0.65],
    leftPalm: [24, 17, 4, -0.20], rightPalm: [-24, 18, -2, 0.39],
    legs: [0.02, 0.014, 1, -0.07, -0.018, 2], mouth: [0.89, 2.7, 0.30], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 1530, body: [93, 217, 1.010, 0.929, 1.025, 0.042, 0.033, 0.010],
    left: [50, 136, 48, 57, 118, 62, 1.08, 1.16, 0.42, 0.10, 0.48],
    right: [153, 136, 23, 167, 128, 27, 0.91, 1.15, 0.08, 0.23, 0.63],
    leftPalm: [-8, 27, 1, 2.83], rightPalm: [26, -8, 4, -0.59],
    legs: [0.03, 0.036, 0, -0.06, -0.029, 2], mouth: [0.88, 2.1, 1.15], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 2330, body: [109, 248, 1.455, 1.350, 1.305, -0.018, 0.009, 0.018],
    left: [32, 179, 0, 13, 197, 4, 0.96, 1.04, 0.10, 0.12, 0.12],
    right: [180, 180, -21, 183, 215, -14, 0.94, 1.00, 0.00, 0.06, 0.05],
    leftPalm: [-26, -15, 2, 0.16], rightPalm: [7, -26, 4, -0.22],
    legs: [0.02, 0.010, 1, -0.03, -0.010, 1], mouth: [0.90, 2.2, -3.20], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 3130, body: [99, 219, 1.155, 1.040, 1.115, -0.155, 0.027, 0.010],
    left: [49, 127, 34, 95, 124, 78, 1.38, 1.48, 0.86, 0.06, 0.47],
    right: [158, 178, -10, 162, 205, -1, 1.00, 1.00, 0.01, 0.11, 0.06],
    leftPalm: [-22, 17, -1, 0.24], rightPalm: [10, -27, 3, -0.21],
    legs: [0.02, 0.025, 0, 0.02, -0.045, 0], mouth: [0.95, 2.4, 0.20], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 3930, body: [124, 216, 1.030, 0.980, 1.125, -1.265, 0.113, 0.005],
    left: [56, 110, -20, 29, 90, -8, 1.03, 1.05, -0.03, 0.18, 0.58],
    right: [61, 110, 43, 44, 59, 46, 0.88, 1.09, -0.07, 0.66, 0.74],
    leftPalm: [-27, 10, 3, -0.94], rightPalm: [5, 27, 5, 0.70],
    legs: [-0.23, 0.002, 9, -0.18, 0.005, 6], mouth: [0.93, 2.2, 0.25], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 4670, body: [139, 217, 1.050, 0.985, 1.180, -1.475, 0.154, -0.010],
    left: [58, 113, -23, 28, 96, -10, 1.00, 1.02, -0.05, 0.23, 0.59],
    right: [55, 119, 44, 42, 83, 43, 0.88, 1.08, -0.12, 0.68, 0.68],
    leftPalm: [-27, 10, 3, -0.93], rightPalm: [-10, 24, 5, 0.61],
    legs: [-0.32, 0.015, 10, -0.14, -0.012, 4], mouth: [0.93, 2.0, 0.10], eyes: 1
  },
  {
    t: 5470, body: [146, 223, 1.060, 1.040, 1.200, -1.615, 0.211, -0.014],
    left: [107, 158, -40, 129, 213, -24, 0.95, 1.00, 0.02, 0.12, 0.16],
    right: [132, 163, 47, 148, 216, 42, 1.02, 1.10, 0.11, 0.10, 0.56],
    leftPalm: [8, -26, 4, -0.24], rightPalm: [17, -23, 2, 0.43],
    legs: [-0.29, 0.01, 15, -0.36, -0.013, 9], mouth: [0.93, 2.1, 0.04], eyes: 1
  }
];
for (const frame of frames) {
  frame.leftOrientation = frame.leftPalm ? palmRotation(left, frame.leftPalm) : new THREE.Quaternion();
  frame.rightOrientation = frame.rightPalm ? palmRotation(right, frame.rightPalm) : new THREE.Quaternion();
}
frames.push({ ...frames[0], t: duration });

function slope(a, b) {
  return a * b > 0 ? 2 * a * b / (a + b) : 0;
}

function sample(field, index, u) {
  const a = frames[index];
  const b = frames[index + 1];
  const span = b.t - a.t;
  const previous = frames[index - 1];
  const next = frames[index + 2];
  const u2 = u * u;
  const u3 = u2 * u;
  return a[field].map((value, j) => {
    const target = b[field][j];
    const middle = (target - value) / span;
    const m0 = previous && index < frames.length - 2
      ? slope((value - previous[field][j]) / (a.t - previous.t), middle) : 0;
    const m1 = next && index + 1 < frames.length - 2
      ? slope(middle, (next[field][j] - target) / (next.t - b.t)) : 0;
    return (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * value + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * span * m0
         + (-2 * u3 + 3 * u2) * target + (u3 - u2) * span * m1;
  });
}

const offsetVector = new THREE.Vector3();
const rotatedNormal = new THREE.Vector3();
const newTangent = new THREE.Vector3();
const oldTangent = new THREE.Vector3();
const bandRotation = new THREE.Quaternion();
const armWidth = [-0.43, -0.21, 0.035, 0.27, 1.18];

function poseArm(rig, pose, orientation, inverseRoot, atRest) {
  const [ex, ey, ez, wx, wy, wz, size, width, spread, curl, girth] = pose;
  const geometry = rig.mesh.geometry;
  const pos = geometry.getAttribute('position');
  const nor = geometry.getAttribute('normal');
  const targetElbow = rig.arm.worldToLocal(point(ex, ey, ez));
  const targetWrist = rig.arm.worldToLocal(point(wx, wy, wz));
  rig.hand.position.copy(targetWrist);
  rig.hand.quaternion.copy(inverseRoot).multiply(orientation);
  rig.hand.scale.set(size * width, size, size * Math.sqrt(width));
  rig.material.uniforms.raised.value = girth;

  rig.digits.forEach((digit, i) => {
    digit.rotation.x = curl * (i === 4 ? 0.54 : 1.04 + 0.07 * i);
    digit.rotation.z = spread * armWidth[i] * (rig.side === 'left' ? 1 : -1);
  });

  if (atRest) {
    pos.array.set(rig.positions);
    nor.array.set(rig.normals);
    rig.hand.position.copy(rig.wristLocal);
  } else {
    const dElbow = targetElbow.clone().sub(rig.elbow);
    const dWrist = targetWrist.clone().sub(rig.wristLocal);
    const restForearm = rig.wristLocal.clone().sub(rig.elbow).normalize();
    const posedForearm = targetWrist.clone().sub(targetElbow).normalize();
    const wristY = rig.wrist[1];
    const dEnd = posedForearm.sub(restForearm)
      .multiplyScalar(rig.end - wristY).add(dWrist);
    const path = [
      [rig.start, 0, 0, 0],
      [rig.shoulderY, 0, 0, 0],
      [rig.elbowY, ...dElbow.toArray()],
      [wristY, ...dWrist.toArray()],
      [rig.end, ...dEnd.toArray()]
    ];

    rig.bands.forEach((band, j) => {
      const { y, center, derivative } = band;
      const [dx, dy, dz] = profile(path, y);
      const low = Math.max(rig.start, y - 0.08);
      const high = Math.min(rig.end, y + 0.08);
      const a = profile(path, low);
      const b = profile(path, high);
      const step = 1 / (high - low);
      newTangent.set(derivative.x + (b[0] - a[0]) * step,
                     derivative.y + (b[1] - a[1]) * step,
                     derivative.z + (b[2] - a[2]) * step).normalize();
      oldTangent.copy(derivative).normalize();
      if (newTangent.lengthSq() < 0.001) newTangent.copy(oldTangent);
      bandRotation.setFromUnitVectors(oldTangent, newTangent);
      const startBlend = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, rig.start, rig.shoulderY + 25);
      const endBlend = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, wristY - 18, rig.end);
      const thickness = 1 + girth * 0.66 * startBlend * endBlend;

      for (let i = 0; i < rig.sides; i++) {
        const vertex = j * rig.sides + i;
        offsetVector.fromArray(rig.positions, vertex * 3).sub(center)
          .multiplyScalar(thickness).applyQuaternion(bandRotation);
        pos.setXYZ(vertex, center.x + dx + offsetVector.x,
                   center.y + dy + offsetVector.y, center.z + dz + offsetVector.z);
        rotatedNormal.fromArray(rig.normals, vertex * 3).applyQuaternion(bandRotation);
        nor.setXYZ(vertex, rotatedNormal.x, rotatedNormal.y, rotatedNormal.z);
      }
      if (j === 0 || j === rig.bands.length - 1) {
        const cap = rig.bands.length * rig.sides + (j === 0 ? 0 : 1);
        pos.setXYZ(cap, center.x + dx, center.y + dy, center.z + dz);
        rotatedNormal.fromArray(rig.normals, cap * 3).applyQuaternion(bandRotation);
        nor.setXYZ(cap, rotatedNormal.x, rotatedNormal.y, rotatedNormal.z);
      }
    });
  }
  pos.needsUpdate = true;
  nor.needsUpdate = true;
  geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
}

const qYaw = new THREE.Quaternion();
const qPitch = new THREE.Quaternion();
const inverseRoot = new THREE.Quaternion();
const leftOrientation = new THREE.Quaternion();
const rightOrientation = new THREE.Quaternion();
const characters = [character];

function render(t) {
  const ticks = duration * 1000;
  const time = ((Math.round(t * 1000) % ticks + ticks) % ticks) / 1000;
  let index = 0;
  while (time >= frames[index + 1].t) index++;
  const a = frames[index];
  const b = frames[index + 1];
  const u = (time - a.t) / (b.t - a.t);
  const eased = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);

  const [x, y, sx, sy, sz, yaw, lean, pitch] = sample('body', index, u);
  character.position.copy(point(x, y, 0));
  character.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  character.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(frontAxis, lean)
    .multiply(qYaw.setFromAxisAngle(upAxis, yaw))
    .multiply(qPitch.setFromAxisAngle(sideAxis, pitch));
  inverseRoot.copy(character.quaternion).invert();

  const legPose = sample('legs', index, u);
  legs.forEach((leg, i) => {
    leg.rotation.set(legPose[i * 3], 0, legPose[i * 3 + 1]);
    leg.position.z = -3 + legPose[i * 3 + 2];
  });

  character.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  leftOrientation.copy(a.leftOrientation).slerp(b.leftOrientation, eased);
  rightOrientation.copy(a.rightOrientation).slerp(b.rightOrientation, eased);
  poseArm(left, sample('left', index, u), leftOrientation, inverseRoot, time === 0);
  poseArm(right, sample('right', index, u), rightOrientation, inverseRoot, time === 0);

  let open = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a.eyes, b.eyes, eased);
  if (index === 0) open = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(time, 95, 440);
  const blink = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(Math.abs(time - 2815), 8, 88);
  open *= 1 - 0.96 * blink;
  eyelidSkin.uniforms.strength.value = 1 - open;
  eyeShadow.uniforms.strength.value = 0.55 * (1 - open);
  irisSkin.uniforms.openness.value = open;
  poseMouth(sample('mouth', index, u));

  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters, render, ready: true };
</script>
